candidate_selection: equal-weight RRF of existing BM25 top 50 and dense top 50; take fused top 50
tie_break: descending reranker logit, then ascending stable chunk ID
timing: one full 50-candidate scoring pass per development question; tokenize+inference+sort; model loading and retrieval excluded
selection_policy: One model/configuration for this stage, fixed before scoring; report regressions without trying alternatives.
pool_policy: Retain old judgments; judge every new top-10 passage before comparing all four methods on one expanded pool.
heldout_policy: Do not execute heldout-v1 during development or use it to tune this configuration. Later final run must record this freeze hash.
